required.quote: Any person owning or possessing bees shall on or before the first day of June of each year, or thereafter within thirty days after coming into ownership or possession of bees, or upon moving bees into this state from outside the state, file with the director of agriculture an application for registration

interval_years.quote: All registrations issued in accordance with this section expire on the following thirty-first day of May and shall be renewed according to the standard renewal procedure of sections 4745.01 to 4745.03 of the Revised Code.

available.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, a licensing authority shall issue a license or government certification to an applicant if the licensing authority determines that all of the following apply

requirements.value: Under Chapter 4796, out-of-state licensees may obtain OH registration if they hold a substantially similar out-of-state occupational license, have held it for at least one year, are actively engaged in the profession, are in good standing, and meet other requirements of section 4796.03.

exists.quote: The director of agriculture shall appoint a competent entomologist as state apiarist and such number of deputy state apiarists as are necessary to carry out sections 909.01 to 909.18

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of Chapter 909 or any rule or order promulgated under it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: may suspend or revoke any registration, certificate, or permit issued under this chapter, or a compliance agreement entered into under this chapter, for cause, including any violation of this chapter or nonconformity with any rule or order promulgated under this chapter

definition_quote.value: The moving, raising, and production of bees, beeswax, honey, and honey products shall be deemed an agricultural pursuit.
definition_quote.quote: The moving, raising, and production of bees, beeswax, honey, and honey products shall be deemed an agricultural pursuit.

registration_required.quote: No person shall maintain an apiary unless the apiary is registered under this section

apiary_identification_required.quote: No person shall maintain an apiary unless the apiary is registered under this section and identifiable by name or identification number assigned to such person by the director. Such identification number shall be posted in a conspicuous location in the apiary.

apiary_location_reporting_required.quote: file with the director of agriculture an application for registration setting forth the exact location of the person's apiaries

movable_frame_hive_required.quote: No person shall keep or maintain bees in any hive if all frames and honeycombs cannot be readily removed therefrom for inspection

neglected_abandoned_hive_nuisance_declar.quote: All cross-comb hives or domiciles for bees, from which the frames and honeycombs cannot be readily removed, are hereby declared to be a public nuisance.

import_permit_required.quote: No person shall ship or move bee colonies or any used beekeeping equipment into this state from any other state or country without an inspection certificate issued by an authorized inspector from the state or country wherein shipment or movement originated.

import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: No person shall ship or move bee colonies or any used beekeeping equipment into this state from any other state or country without an inspection certificate issued by an authorized inspector from the state or country wherein shipment or movement originated.

africanized_bee_regulated.quote: No person shall ship or move into this state any Africanized honey bees.

regulated_diseases.quote: The director of agriculture may make and enforce such rules and orders as in his judgment are necessary to control, eradicate, or prevent the introduction, spread, or dissemination of any bee diseases or Africanized honey bees.

quarantine_authority.quote: the director of agriculture may establish and maintain quarantine orders prohibiting the shipment into or within the state, or any subdivision thereof, of any bees, queen bees, used hives or any part thereof, used equipment, or any material capable of transmitting any bee diseases, or Africanized honey bees

inspector_police_powers.quote: Said state apiarist and deputy state apiarists shall be vested with the powers of police officers in the enforcement of such sections

right_of_entry_scope.quote: the director of agriculture or his authorized representatives, during daylight hours, shall have access to and egress from any apiary or to any premises, buildings, or any other place, public or private

queen_rearing_apiary_certification_requi.quote: Each person within the state that intends to sell, trade, gift, or otherwise distribute queen bees, packaged bees, nucs, or colonies shall file with the department of agriculture a request for the certification of all of the person's queen rearing apiaries

transfer_permit_required_for_diseased_eq.quote: No person shall sell, offer for sale, give, trade, or otherwise distribute any bees, honeycombs, or used beekeeping equipment that contains a serious bee disease or pest.

beekeeping_classified_as_agricultural_pr.quote: The moving, raising, and production of bees, beeswax, honey, and honey products shall be deemed an agricultural pursuit.

inspection_fee_charged.quote: The cost of the inspection shall be paid upon completion in an amount determined by rule of the director.
